result.result:
I repaired the network by feeding it an estimate of the dead W2 pocket readings, and it now scores 45.2 veh-h on dev, against 214.3 before the fix.

**What I changed and why:** with W2 reading 0, the network almost never chose the EW_left phase under heavy load. The left-turn pockets overflowed, the queued left-turners blocked the straight traffic behind them, and the junction gridlocked. I left the two dead input columns alone and added them onto the columns of working inputs, so the network sees this estimate in their place:

W2 estimate = E2 + 0.6·(t_green − 0.2) − 0.25·(phase is EW_left) + 3·q_W1u

- **E2** is the opposite left-turn pocket, served by the same phase with the same demand.
- **The timer term** makes an idle junction eventually serve EW_left, so W left-turners the network can't see don't wait until the drain cap.
- **The EW_left correction** stops the timer from holding EW_left on its own.
- **The q_W1u term** detects W2 overflowing into the upstream lane.

**Parameters changed:** 368 (308 in W1, 60 in b1).

**Simulator calls:** 7 of 10.

| call | version | dev TTS |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | E2 estimate only | 46.0, with 7 vehicles left at the drain cap |
| 2 | + timer | 45.7, 1 vehicle left |
| 3 | + EW_left correction + overflow term (final) | **45.2**, none left |
| 4 | stronger overflow term | 45.2 |
| 5 | without the overflow term | 45.5 |
| 6–7 | + fix for a lone car on lane N1 being ignored (a flaw of the original network) | 45.3 / 45.5, so not used |

**Dev TTS of final weights:** 45.2 (low 34.8, nominal 45.5, high 55.4). The network with every detector working scores 44.5.

**Test predictions:** low 34.9, nominal 45.5, high 56.0.

All three deliverables are in `work/`.
